# gyro_server_nic (Resource)

A private network card: attaches a Gyro Cloud Istanbul (tr-ist-1) server to a subnet of a gyro_vpc (free). The card is configured inside the server automatically; no reboot. Up to 3 cards per server; a server can be in one VPC at a time (several subnets of it are fine). Create waits until the card is ready (up to 5 minutes), destroy waits until it is gone. Every attribute is ForceNew.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Attach a tr-ist-1 server to the "app" subnet (next free address)
resource "gyro_server_nic" "web" {
  server_id = gyro_server.web.id
  subnet_id = gyro_subnet.app.subnet_id
}

# Fixed private address in the subnet created with the VPC
resource "gyro_server_nic" "db" {
  server_id = gyro_server.db.id
  subnet_id = gyro_vpc.uretim.default_subnet_id
  ip        = "10.10.0.20"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (Number) tr-ist-1 server id.
- `subnet_id` (String) Subnet id (gyro_subnet.subnet_id or gyro_vpc.default_subnet_id).

### Optional

- `ip` (String) Private IPv4 of the server in the subnet. Leave it out to get the next free address.

### Read-Only

- `gateway_ip` (String) Gateway address of the subnet.
- `id` (String) <server_id>/<nic_id>
- `mac` (String) MAC address of the card.
- `nic_id` (String) Network card id.
- `state` (String) attaching, ready, detaching or error.
- `vpc_id` (String) VPC of the subnet.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import gyro_server_nic.web 123/45
```
